operationId.description: A stable caller-generated identifier used to recover the result of an uncertain operation.

target.description: An account DID or handle, or a record AT URI.

value.description: A label value declared by the current issuance policy.

reason.description: A nonblank explanation retained with the administrative operation.

cid.description: An optional record version; requires a record AT URI target.

expiresAt.description: An optional absolute expiry used by issueLabel; negateLabel does not use this field.

correlationId.description: An optional diagnostic identifier for correlating the operation with caller logs.

operationId.description: The stable identifier supplied with the operation.

sequence.description: The label-stream sequence assigned to the operation, when a label event was appended.

changed.description: Whether the operation changed the current label state.

value.description: The label value declared by the issuance policy.

applied.description: Whether this label is currently active for the requested target and version.

sequence.description: The label-stream sequence associated with the current label state, or zero when none exists.

otherVersion.description: Whether the label is active on another record version.

uriWide.description: Whether the active label applies to the record URI without a CID restriction.

expiresAt.description: The expiry of the active label, when it has one.

labelChoices.description: The policy-declared label values and, when a target was requested, their current state.

moderation.description: The declared label choices and optional target-state details.

target.description: The canonical target identifier when current target state was requested.
